author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: I'm looking for help with this - SMCI stock - browse the stock page, news, and read an article. Email a balanced research note to diana.park@seoulfin.com covering valuation, growth drivers, and key risks. Include SMCI's current stock price in your email. Mention SMCI's P/E ratio in the research note. Reference SMCI's industry classification in the analysis.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a server infrastructure analyst at Dataflow Capital Research. You cover the AI server hardware sector and provide research-driven investment analysis to clients. Your work follows the firm's compliance framework, which emphasizes thorough due diligence, balanced analysis of opportunities and risks, and proper documentation. You have access to tools that let you browse stock data, news, portfolio information, and send communications.
Current date and time: Monday, December 1, 2025, 1:30 PM ET (market open, mid-day trading session).
eval_task:
def eval_task(self, agent_responses=None):
        """Check: email sent to correct recipient + data grounding."""
        msgs = search_messages(token=self.gmail_token, to_address="diana.park@seoulfin.com")
        if not msgs:
            return False, {"email_sent": False}
        # Data-grounding checks on email body
        body = get_message_body(self.gmail_token, (msgs[0].get("ID") or msgs[0].get("id") or ""))
        body_lower = body.lower()
        price_mentioned = any(kw.lower() in body_lower for kw in ['33.6', '33.7'])
        pe_mentioned = any(kw.lower() in body_lower for kw in ['23.1', '23.12', '23.13'])
        industry_mentioned = any(kw.lower() in body_lower for kw in ['Computer Hardware'])
        data_ok = price_mentioned and pe_mentioned and industry_mentioned
        ok = data_ok
        return ok, {"email_sent": True, "messages_found": len(msgs), "price_mentioned": price_mentioned, "pe_mentioned": pe_mentioned, "industry_mentioned": industry_mentioned, "data_grounded": data_ok}
